description: Knowledge-store capture overlay. A PreToolUse hook captures a worktree's artifacts synchronously, immediately before a `git worktree remove` destroys them; a PostToolUse hook captures a freshly-opened PR and kicks extraction, detached. Both are inert — one `test`, then gone — in every repo without an executable `.knowledge-store/capture`, and both exit 0 on every path, because a PreToolUse hook's exit 2 cancels the user's command.
